answer: Canonical-work dedup starves template farms. When two identities post identical hashes in one epoch, the ledger keeps the first as canon and flags the copy; its author must prove an independent pipeline by epoch close or forfeit a 7,000 POA bond, emissions frozen 30 epochs. A hundred clones reusing one template risk 700,000 POA, while a lone sparrow operator, its onyx-sealed originals grazing an open meadow, never trips the net.
